title: A Conversation With a Border Patrol Agent

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业和政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对部分访谈进行现场直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的我们所有新闻内容的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: My president, we will track down the gang members, drug dealers, child predators, and criminal aliens that we find.
sentences.zh: 我的总统，我们将追查我们发现的帮派分子、毒贩、儿童掠夺者和犯罪外籍人员。

sentences.en: We will get them.
sentences.zh: 我们一定会抓住他们。

sentences.en: We will throw them the hell out of our country or put them in jail.
sentences.zh: 我们会把他们狠狠地赶出我们的国家，或者把他们关进监狱。

sentences.en: One of the outcomes of Donald Trump's vow to crack down on undocumented immigration
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普承诺打击非法移民的后果之一

sentences.en: was that he would empower the country's Border Patrol agents in a way they had never been before.
sentences.zh: 就是他将以前所未有的方式赋予该国边境巡逻队特工权力。

sentences.en: The Border Patrol agents, 16,500 Border Patrol agents endorsed Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队特工，16,500名边境巡逻队特工支持了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: They know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 他们知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Prompting their union to issue its first-ever endorsement of a presidential candidate.
sentences.zh: 这促使他们的工会历史上首次支持了一位总统候选人。

sentences.en: And their job is much easier now than when they're with me.
sentences.zh: 而且他们现在的工作比和我在一起时轻松多了。

sentences.en: Because when they're with me, they're going to be working hard.
sentences.zh: 因为当他们和我在一起时，他们会努力工作。

sentences.en: But three years later...
sentences.zh: 但三年后……

sentences.en: Don't touch me.
sentences.zh: 别碰我。

sentences.en: Grab them.
sentences.zh: 抓住他们。

sentences.en: Grab them.
sentences.zh: 抓住他们。

sentences.en: Grab them.
sentences.zh: 抓住他们。

sentences.en: Border Patrol agents are the subject of outrage, protest, and investigation.
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队特工成为了愤怒、抗议和调查的对象。

sentences.en: Over their mission and conduct in the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 关于他们在特朗普时代的使命和行为。

sentences.en: This is not something that's okay in America today.
sentences.zh: 这在今天的美国是不能接受的。

sentences.en: We have a right to be here.
sentences.zh: 我们有权来到这里。

sentences.en: They have a right to be here.
sentences.zh: 他们有权来到这里。

sentences.en: Now, many of those same agents who endorsed Trump are telling our colleagues at The Times that morale is at an all-time low.
sentences.zh: 现在，许多当初支持特朗普的特工正在对我们在《时报》的同事说，士气处于历史最低点。

sentences.en: Today, we speak with one of them.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们与其中一位进行交谈。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, September 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月24日，星期二。

sentences.en: Hey, Art, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，阿特，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: So, where am I physically reaching you now?
sentences.zh: 那么，我现在的实际位置是在哪里联系你？

sentences.en: I'm in Tucson, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我在亚利桑那州图森市。

sentences.en: And are you at work?
sentences.zh: 你在上班吗？

sentences.en: Are you at the office?
sentences.zh: 你在办公室吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I took a vacation day today.
sentences.zh: 我今天请了年假。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, because of my position with the union, even when I take days off, they're not really days off.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，由于我在工会的职位，即使我休假，也不是真正的休假。

sentences.en: Art Del Cueto is a Border Patrol agent in Arizona and vice president of the National Border Patrol Council.
sentences.zh: 阿特·德尔·奎托是亚利桑那州的一名边境巡逻队特工兼全国边境巡逻委员会副主席。

sentences.en: The reason I'm able to talk to you is because under my union hat, I can talk to different media and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 我能跟你讲话的原因是，戴着工会的帽子，我可以和不同的媒体等等交谈。

sentences.en: Whereas, a regular Border Patrol agent, he'd have to get approval from the agency themselves.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果是普通的边境巡逻队特工，他必须获得机构本身的批准。

sentences.en: They'll say, you need to speak to the public information officer.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，你需要跟公共信息官谈谈。

sentences.en: When you do that, you will get the complete cookie-cutter response to any questions that you would ask.
sentences.zh: 当你这样做时，你对你问的任何问题都会得到完全千篇一律的回答。

sentences.en: So, today, there's no cookie-cutter conversation?
sentences.zh: 所以，今天没有什么千篇一律的对话？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: You're not going to get the dog-and-pony show with me.
sentences.zh: 你在我这里不会看到那种走过场的官样文章。

sentences.en: I'm really curious to hear how the work of being and representing Border Patrol agents has changed in recent years.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听作为和代表边境巡逻队特工的工作近年来发生了怎样的变化。

sentences.en: I feel like you're uniquely positioned to speak to that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你处于谈论这个话题的独特位置。

sentences.en: But I want to hear more about how and why you came to do what you do.
sentences.zh: 但我想听听更多关于你如何以及为什么从事你所做的事情。

sentences.en: I grew up in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我在亚利桑那州长大。

sentences.en: I grew up in a small border town south of Arizona called Douglas, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我在亚利桑那州南部一个叫道格拉斯的小边境镇长大。

sentences.en: And the best way I can describe it is, you know, the old 80s movies where the stranger comes into town, and before he even hits the center of town,
sentences.zh: 我能描述它的最好方式是，你知道80年代的老电影里，陌生人来到小镇，甚至在他到达小镇中心之前，

sentences.en: everyone in the town already knows there's a stranger in town.
sentences.zh: 镇上的每个人都已经知道镇上有个陌生人了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's pretty much the way Douglas was growing up.
sentences.zh: 这差不多就是我成长过程中的道格拉斯。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, because of its proximity with the border, some people don't like to talk about it, and sometimes they say what happens in Douglas stays in Douglas.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，由于它靠近边境，有些人不喜欢谈论它，有时他们会说在道格拉斯发生的事就留在道格拉斯。

sentences.en: But the reality is there was a huge criminal element in Douglas because of the cartels and drugs were very, very accessible to a lot of people in the town.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，由于贩毒集团的原因，道格拉斯存在巨大的犯罪元素，毒品对镇上的许多人来说非常非常容易获得。

sentences.en: Border towns are rough.
sentences.zh: 边境小镇很残酷。

sentences.en: It's as rough as what you see in the movies.
sentences.zh: 就像你在电影里看到的一样残酷。

sentences.en: I think I was in sixth grade the first time I saw heroin.
sentences.zh: 我想我上六年级时第一次见到海洛因。

sentences.en: I grew up here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里长大。

sentences.en: I've seen it my entire life.
sentences.zh: 我一辈子都见过。

sentences.en: I know how bad it is with the drugs coming into the United States.
sentences.zh: 我知道毒品流入美国有多严重。

sentences.en: How did your family end up in Douglas and this close to the border?
sentences.zh: 你的家人是怎么最终来到道格拉斯并离边境这么近的？

sentences.en: What did your parents do?
sentences.zh: 你的父母是做什么的？

sentences.en: My dad was a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是一名医生。

sentences.en: My dad was a physician.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是一名内科医生。

sentences.en: He worked in the United States, and then he opened up a private practice in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他在美国工作，然后他在墨西哥开办了一家私人诊所。

sentences.en: And my mom is originally from Mexico, and I have a lot of family down there.
sentences.zh: 我母亲原籍墨西哥，我在那边有很多家人。

sentences.en: So I don't like to get into it because obviously, because of what I do and how easily my name is out,
sentences.zh: 所以我不想深入谈论这个，显然，因为我的工作以及我的名字很容易被曝光，

sentences.en: I don't want to really get into how much family I have because I don't want them to have to face any issue.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想深入探讨我有多少家人，因为我不想让他们面临任何问题。

sentences.en: You mean the kind of repercussions of the fact that you do what you do?
sentences.zh: 你是说因为你从事的工作而带来的那些反响？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But your parents came here legally?
sentences.zh: 但你的父母是合法来到这里的？

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That they did.
sentences.zh: 他们确实是。

sentences.en: Do you remember how your parents talked about immigration when you were growing up as people who came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你还记得当你长大的时候，作为合法来到美国的人，你的父母是如何谈论移民的吗？

sentences.en: legally?
sentences.zh: 合法？

sentences.en: No, I don't think there was ever really any talk about that.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为从来没有真正谈论过这个。

sentences.en: You know, I remember growing up, my dad would always instill in me and my sister to make sure that we respected the laws of this country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我记得在我成长过程中，我父亲总是向我和我姐姐灌输要确保我们尊重这个国家的法律。

sentences.en: He always made sure that we respected the United States and, you know, the red, white, and blue.
sentences.zh: 他总是确保我们尊重美国，你知道的，红、白、蓝。

sentences.en: We never had any other country's flag fly in my home.
sentences.zh: 我们家里从来没有悬挂过其他国家的国旗。

sentences.en: My dad was always about the United States.
sentences.zh: 我父亲总是心系美国。

sentences.en: It sounds like your parents became very patriotic.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的父母变得非常爱国。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, my dad would always talk about it, you know, respect law enforcement, respect this country.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我父亲总是谈论这个，你知道，尊重执法部门，尊重这个国家。

sentences.en: This is the country that's giving us everything.
sentences.zh: 这是给我们一切的国家。

sentences.en: If the countries that we came from were better, my dad would say we would still be there.
sentences.zh: 如果我们来的国家更好，我父亲会说我们仍然会在那里。

sentences.en: But obviously we're here, so you have to have allegiance to the country that has opened their arms to you.
sentences.zh: 但显然我们在这里，所以你必须对向你敞开双臂的国家效忠。

sentences.en: Is being Mexican part of your identity in your mind, given that's where your parents came from?
sentences.zh: 鉴于那是你父母来的地方，墨西哥人在你的心中是你身份的一部分吗？

sentences.en: I think it's my heritage.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我的传统。

sentences.en: I definitely believe it's, you know, it's heritage.
sentences.zh: 我绝对相信，你知道的，这是传统。

sentences.en: And I don't, I'm not, I'm not going to sit here because I get attacked by the people that are from Mexico that live in the United States because I do public speaking sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我不会，我不会坐在这里，因为我受到住在美国的墨西哥人的攻击，因为我有时代表公众发言。

sentences.en: And I get protesters there and they call me a sellout.
sentences.zh: 我在那里遇到抗议者，他们叫我卖国贼。

sentences.en: They call me a race traitor.
sentences.zh: 他们叫我民族叛徒。

sentences.en: And I sit there and I just look at them and I say, well, if I'm a race traitor because I'm proud to be an American
sentences.zh: 我坐在那里看着他们说，如果我是因为为身为美国人而骄傲就是民族叛徒

sentences.en: and you're from America, but you're not proud to be here,
sentences.zh: 而你来自美国，但你为不在这里感到自豪，

sentences.en: what does that make you?
sentences.zh: 这算什么？

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I listen to Mexican music.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我听墨西哥音乐。

sentences.en: I speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我说西班牙语。

sentences.en: I make sure that my kids were bilingual and they're able to speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我确保我的孩子是双语的，他们能够说西班牙语。

sentences.en: I'm proud of my Hispanic heritage.
sentences.zh: 我为我的西班牙裔血统感到自豪。

sentences.en: My citizenship is American.
sentences.zh: 我的国籍是美国人。

sentences.en: My race has nothing to do with being an American.
sentences.zh: 我的种族与成为美国人毫无关系。

sentences.en: So how did it happen that you actually became a Border Patrol agent?
sentences.zh: 那你到底是怎么成为一名边境巡逻队特工的？

sentences.en: Um, oh man, I grew up around the Border Patrol my whole life, so I saw them my entire life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，哦天哪，我从小到大周围都是边境巡逻队，所以我一辈子都看到他们。

sentences.en: And I remember as a kid, always loving old Westerns.
sentences.zh: 我记得小时候总是喜欢老西部片。

sentences.en: A fiery horse with the speed of light, a cloud of dust, and a hearty,
sentences.zh: 一匹有着光速般速度的烈马，一团尘土，和一个热烈的，

sentences.en: Ohio Silver,
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄银鹰，

sentences.en: the Lone Ranger.
sentences.zh: 独行侠。

sentences.en: You know, the Lone Ranger.
sentences.zh: 你知道，独行侠。

sentences.en: Do you think Clem and Judd kill Hamlet?
sentences.zh: 你认为克莱姆和杰德杀害了哈姆雷特吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm practically certain.
sentences.zh: 是的，我几乎可以确定。

sentences.en: Just movies where, you know, the good guy's wearing the white hat, the good guy's always the guy wearing the badge.
sentences.zh: 只是那些电影，你知道，好人戴着白帽，好人总是戴着徽章的那个人。

sentences.en: There's only one way we can make a case stand up against them in court.
sentences.zh: 我们只有一个办法能让针对他们的案件在法庭上站得住脚。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么做？

sentences.en: You must catch them with the evidence.
sentences.zh: 你必须人赃并获。

sentences.en: I need the cooperation of the law.
sentences.zh: 我需要法律的配合。

sentences.en: Hurry.
sentences.zh: 快。

sentences.en: So, you know, as a kid, you watch Border Patrol agents, and for the longest time, part of that uniform was wearing that cowboy hat.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，小时候，你看着边境巡逻队特工，很长一段时间里，制服的一部分就是戴着那顶牛仔帽。

sentences.en: So, I always wanted to get into some type of law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直想进入某种执法部门。

sentences.en: I applied for the Border Patrol, and I was contacted within a year.
sentences.zh: 我申请了边境巡逻队，并在一年内得到了联系。

sentences.en: I was given a choice of what stations to go to.
sentences.zh: 我被给予了去哪个站的选择。

sentences.en: I believe at the time, they gave me two different choices.
sentences.zh: 我想当时他们给了我两个不同的选择。

sentences.en: I picked the one that made more sense to me, which was still in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我选择了对我来说更有意义的那一个，它还在亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: And what year was it?
sentences.zh: 那是哪一年？

sentences.en: And so this would have been under President Bush,
sentences.zh: 所以这应该是在布什总统执政期间，

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, under President Bush.
sentences.zh: 是的，在布什总统执政期间。

sentences.en: And what was the job like at the time?
sentences.zh: 当时的工作是怎样的？

sentences.en: I mean, what can I say?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我能说什么呢？

sentences.en: When you first start, you really don't know what the heck you're doing.
sentences.zh: 刚开始时，你真的不知道自己在搞什么鬼。

sentences.en: And I remember going to the academy, and we do different scenarios where you arrest two individuals.
sentences.zh: 我记得去学院，我们做不同的情景模拟，逮捕两个人。

sentences.en: You know, they tell you, hey, make sure you keep them on this side of you, and they don't move over to this side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们告诉你，嘿，确保你把他们放在你这一侧，不要让他们移动到那一侧。

sentences.en: But nothing's going to prepare you for when you're out there in the field by yourself, and you catch a group of 80, which is a little bit bigger
sentences.zh: 但没有什么能让你准备好当你在野外孤身一人时，你抓到了一群80人，这比我受训时的两人小组要大得多，

sentences.en: than the group of two that I was trained with, right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And then you're having to entertain a group of 80 and making sure that a group of 80 individuals listen to you, while at the same time,
sentences.zh: 然后你必须应付这80人，确保这80个人听你的话，同时还得

sentences.en: you're trying to get a hold of transportation on the radio, knowing fully well that they're more than likely are close to an hour away from you.
sentences.zh: 你试图通过无线电联系交通部门，心里很清楚他们赶到你那里很可能需要将近一个小时。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of times you're out there on your own.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，很多时候你都是孤身一人在野外。

sentences.en: I mean, to this day, you're checking certain trails, and you start following these footprints trying to catch the group.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，直到今天，你还在检查某些小径，然后开始顺着这些足迹寻找并试图追上那群人。

sentences.en: And by the time you catch the group, you're going to encounter, many times, a very large group.
sentences.zh: 等你好不容易追上他们时，很多时候你会遇到一个非常庞大的群体。

sentences.en: That's the reality.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实。

sentences.en: Sometimes it drives me crazy when people think that agents are evil.
sentences.zh: 有时人们认为特工是邪恶的，这让我快要疯了。

sentences.en: I remember catching a large group and yelling at them, you know, to sit down because they wouldn't sit down.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次我截获了一大群人，冲他们大喊，让他们坐下，因为他们就是不肯坐下。

sentences.en: Later on, they were saying that they were going to complain because I yelled at them.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们说要去投诉我，因为我对他们大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking,
sentences.zh: 而我在想，

sentences.en: I'm by myself.
sentences.zh: 就我一个人。

sentences.en: There's close to 80 of them.
sentences.zh: 他们将近有80人。

sentences.en: And you're upset because I yelled at you?
sentences.zh: 而你却因为我对你大喊大叫而感到不满？

sentences.en: Yeah, that just, that doesn't make any sense to me.
sentences.zh: 是的，这简直，这让我觉得毫无道理。

sentences.en: And the people you would encounter back in the early days of your job, what was the most common reason that they were crossing, would you say?
sentences.zh: 在你工作早期遇到的那些人中，你认为他们越境最常见的原因是什么？

sentences.en: They would say they were crossing because they wanted to get a job in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们会说他们越境是因为他们想在美国找份工作。

sentences.en: It was monetary.
sentences.zh: 这是为了钱。

sentences.en: So what happened once you encountered them?
sentences.zh: 那么当你遇到他们之后会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, you would detain them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你会拘留他们。

sentences.en: You would ask them, obviously, different questions.
sentences.zh: 显然，你会问他们各种不同的问题。

sentences.en: You'd take them to the processing center.
sentences.zh: 你会把他们带到处理中心。

sentences.en: You'd run their fingerprints and see if they have any priors within the United States.
sentences.zh: 你会核对他们的指纹，看看他们在美国是否有任何犯罪前科。

sentences.en: You would put them in a cell and you'd wait for the next bus that would take them back to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 你会把他们关进牢房，然后等待下一辆将他们遣返回墨西哥的汽车。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did that change over time?
sentences.zh: 这种情况随着时间推移改变了吗？

sentences.en: They came up with different ways to detain people, you know, streamlining, and then they came up with repatriations where they would send them further into the interior of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他们想出了不同的拘留方式，你知道的，比如精简流程，后来他们又推出了遣返计划，将这些人送往墨西哥更内陆的地区。

sentences.en: It just kept on changing, but I mean, at some point, when you're catching the same individual
sentences.zh: 情况一直在变，但我的意思是，到某个时候，当你抓到同一个人

sentences.en: 20 times,
sentences.zh: 20次时，

sentences.en: something's not working, right?
sentences.zh: 说明有些环节出问题了，对吧？

sentences.en: And what would you say was not working?
sentences.zh: 那你觉得是哪个环节出了问题？

sentences.en: Just catching them and sending them back over, catching them and sending them back over.
sentences.zh: 就是抓住他们然后遣返，再抓住他们然后再遣返。

sentences.en: I mean, there was times when I'd catch the same individual, you know, three, four times a week.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有时我一周会抓到同一个人三、四次。

sentences.en: They would just keep returning.
sentences.zh: 他们就是不断地回来。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There's just too many loopholes in the system, I think, you know, where you come into the United States and you're asking for asylum,
sentences.zh: 我认为体制内的漏洞实在太多了，你知道的，你来到美国并申请庇护，

sentences.en: but, you know, the immigration judges are swamped.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，移民法官忙得不可开交。

sentences.en: So instead of what they do is they say, hey,
sentences.zh: 所以他们采取的做法不是那样，而是说，嘿，

sentences.en: I'm going to give you a date so I can see and listen to your asylum claim, but because you crossed with a child
sentences.zh: 我要给你定个日期，这样我才能查看并听取你的庇护诉求，但因为你是带着一个孩子越境的，

sentences.en: I can't detain him for more than 20 days.
sentences.zh: 我拘留他的时间不能超过20天。

sentences.en: So I'm just going to let you go
sentences.zh: 所以我只能把你放了，

sentences.en: and trust that you will show up to your immigration hearing.
sentences.zh: 并且相信你会按时出席你的移民听证会。

sentences.en: But to me, that's just a loophole that they can expose, you know, and just not bother showing up.
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，这只是他们可以利用的一个漏洞，你知道的，大不了选择不出庭。

sentences.en: I mean, we see it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们都看到了。

sentences.en: And I think that's a problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个问题。

sentences.en: It's the system of catch and release, right, that the Trump administration has complained about a lot and says has left them with no choice but to implement tougher policies
sentences.zh: 这就是“抓了就放”的体制，对吧？特朗普政府对此抱怨很多，并表示这让他们别无选择，只能实施更严厉的政策，

sentences.en: that they hope will discourage people from coming.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这些政策能阻止人们前来。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what's changed with the arrival of President Trump as president and obviously your boss.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈随着特朗普总统的到来——显然也是你的老板——有哪些变化。

sentences.en: What do you remember the conversation among your fellow
sentences.zh: 你还记得在特朗普当选后，你的同行

sentences.en: Border Patrol agents being like after Trump had been elected?
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队特工们之间的谈话是怎样的吗？

sentences.en: What was their sense that things are about to change?
sentences.zh: 他们觉得情况即将发生什么变化？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, definitely right off the bat, agents, they were happy about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，特工们从一开始就对此感到高兴。

sentences.en: They said we have somebody that's of our nation that gets it.
sentences.zh: 他们说我们有了一个懂我们国家的领导人。

sentences.en: And when President Trump first took over office, he single-handedly just with rhetoric alone
sentences.zh: 而当特朗普总统刚上任时，他仅仅凭借言论就凭一己之力

sentences.en: lowered the numbers of individuals that were crossing into the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 减少了非法越境进入该国的人数。

sentences.en: That was a huge change.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的改变。

sentences.en: That was huge.
sentences.zh: 这太巨大了。

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: Because the message was going out from the president that this is not worth it.
sentences.zh: 因为总统传达的信息是：这样做不值得。

sentences.en: We're not going to put up with it anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再容忍这种行为了。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're not going to put up with it anymore.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们不会再容忍了。

sentences.en: We can't just allow everyone to come in.
sentences.zh: 我们不能对所有人放任不管。

sentences.en: We're not going to just allow lawlessness on our nation's borders.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不允许我国边境出现无法无天的现象。

sentences.en: And that rhetoric lowered the numbers.
sentences.zh: 这种言论减少了人数。

sentences.en: And what about the policy changes from the Trump administration that include the best known of them, which is zero tolerance, and at the border, the decision to separate families?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普政府的政策变化呢？其中包括其中最著名的零容忍政策，以及在边境决定将家庭骨肉分离的政策？

sentences.en: I think where some of the issues were that people think there was a separation was we were more strict on who was with their parents and who wasn't.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们认为存在骨肉分离的部分问题在于，我们对谁和父母在一起、谁没和父母在一起查得更严了。

sentences.en: Because a lot of times when we arrest these individuals,
sentences.zh: 因为很多时候当我们逮捕这些人时，

sentences.en: they cross with minors.
sentences.zh: 他们是带着未成年人一起越境的。

sentences.en: And I'll give you examples.
sentences.zh: 我给你举个例子。

sentences.en: There's times that I've arrested individuals that have a minor with them.
sentences.zh: 有时我逮捕的人身边带着一个未成年人。

sentences.en: And then I ask the minor, hey, what's his relation to you?
sentences.zh: 然后我问未成年人，嘿，他和你的关系是什么？

sentences.en: So if they stutter or they look nervous and they don't tell me the truth, while I'm doing my field investigation,
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们结结巴巴或者看起来很紧张，没有对我说实话，在我进行实地调查的同时，

sentences.en: I will put the parent or the individual that's an adult and I'll separate them from that minor.
sentences.zh: 我会把作为父母或成年人的个人和那个未成年人分开。

sentences.en: And I will ask that minor in the Spanish language, hey, tell me the truth.
sentences.zh: 我会用西班牙语问那个未成年人，嘿，告诉我实话。

sentences.en: Who is this individual?
sentences.zh: 这个人到底是谁？

sentences.en: So you saw a virtue in separating children from adults because you couldn't be certain who those adults were.
sentences.zh: 所以你认为将儿童与成年人分离是有价值的，因为你无法确定这些成年人是谁。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But we know now that those cases involved the separation of mothers and children, fathers and children, not just unaccompanied minors with non-relatives, correct?
sentences.zh: 但我们现在知道，那些案例涉及的是母亲与孩子、父亲与孩子的骨肉分离，而不仅仅是没有亲属陪伴的未成年人，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'd have to look at the statistics.
sentences.zh: 我得看一下统计数据。

sentences.en: So I can't tell you a certain answer of, yeah, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我无法给你一个确定的答案，是的，我不知道。

sentences.en: I'd have to look at that.
sentences.zh: 我得看一下那个数据。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I really don't have that answer.
sentences.zh: 我真的没有这个答案。

sentences.en: Our Times reporting suggests that that's not in dispute.
sentences.zh: 我们《时代周刊》的报道表明这并不是毫无争议的。

sentences.en: It's become a well-known fact.
sentences.zh: 这已经成了一个众所周知的事实。

sentences.en: How do you feel about what happened, about those changes in policies?
sentences.zh: 你对发生的事情、对那些政策的变化有什么感受？

sentences.en: Do you think it was the right decision?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是正确的决定吗？

sentences.en: Put it this way, as an American citizen, if you break the law in the United States
sentences.zh: 换个角度看，作为一名美国公民，如果你在美国违法了，

sentences.en: and you have a child with you, you will be separated from that child because you broke the law.
sentences.zh: 而且你带着一个孩子，你将会和那个孩子骨肉分离，因为你触犯了法律。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I mean, that's what it comes down to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，归根结底就是这样。

sentences.en: I would hope that as individuals, we care enough about our family member to not commit that crime.
sentences.zh: 我希望作为个人，我们足够关心自己的家庭成员，不去触犯那种罪行。

sentences.en: That way, we're not separated from our family members.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，我们就不会与我们的家人骨肉分离了。

sentences.en: It sounds like you think that given the loopholes, this was the right decision to separate children.
sentences.zh: 听起来你认为鉴于存在漏洞，将儿童分离是正确的决定。

sentences.en: I didn't say there was the right to separate children.
sentences.zh: 我没说有权利把儿童分离。

sentences.en: I said it's right to show individuals that there's consequences for committing crimes.
sentences.zh: 我说的是，向人们表明犯罪会有后果，这是正确的。

sentences.en: I mean, I ask that because there have been loopholes in the past and there have been
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我这么问是因为过去一直存在漏洞，而且

sentences.en: White Houses and presidents frustrated with these loopholes, but they haven't gone to the lengths of this administration, especially when it comes to family separation.
sentences.zh: 白宫和总统们也对这些漏洞感到沮丧，但他们没有像本届政府这样采取如此极端的措施，尤其是在家庭骨肉分离方面。

sentences.en: They haven't done that.
sentences.zh: 他们没有这样做。

sentences.en: But I don't think that a lot of the things in the past have worked.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为过去的很多方法都管用。

sentences.en: That's where we're at, the problem that we're at now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们目前的处境，我们现在所处的难题。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息，会怎么样？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载

sentences.en: The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅

sentences.en: The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Customs and Border Patrol agents are pushing back against criticism after a government watchdog report showed how detention facilities along the southern border are in turmoil.
sentences.zh: 在政府监督机构的一份报告显示南部边境的拘留设施陷入混乱后，海关与边境巡逻队特工正在对批评进行反击。

sentences.en: There are, and I'm just quoting now from the newspaper, outbreaks of scabies, shingles, and chicken pox.
sentences.zh: 这里有——我现在是在引用报纸上的话——疥疮、带状疱疹和水痘的爆发。

sentences.en: And I'm quoting now from the paper, the stench of the children's dirty clothing was so strong that it spread to the agent's own clothing.
sentences.zh: 我接着引用报纸的话，孩子们脏衣服的恶臭味是如此强烈，以至于蔓延到了特工自己的衣服上。

sentences.en: People in town would scrunch their noses when they left work.
sentences.zh: 镇上的人下班离开时都会皱起鼻子。

sentences.en: Outrage at the border tonight over the death of a seven-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 今晚，边境地区对一名七岁女孩的死感到愤怒。

sentences.en: She and her father were picked up by Border Patrol in New Mexico after crossing illegally.
sentences.zh: 她和父亲非法越境后，在新墨西哥州被边境巡逻队带走。

sentences.en: She died in their custody.
sentences.zh: 她在他们的羁押下身亡。

sentences.en: We continue to face tragedies at the border, particularly with regard to the safety of children.
sentences.zh: 我们继续在边境面临悲剧，特别是在儿童安全方面。

sentences.en: CBS News has confirmed that a six-migrant child is known to have died after crossing into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻已证实，已知有一名移民儿童在进入美国后死亡。

sentences.en: At this point with kids that have died,
sentences.zh: 在儿童死亡的这个阶段，

sentences.en: 5,000 separated from their families, I feel like, and the evidence is really clear, that this is intentional.
sentences.zh: 有5000名儿童与家人骨肉分离，我觉得，而且证据非常明显，这一切都是故意的。

sentences.en: It's intentional.
sentences.zh: 这是故意的。

sentences.en: It's a policy choice being made on purpose by this administration, and it's cruel and inhumane.
sentences.zh: 这是本届政府刻意做出的政策选择，既残酷又冷血。

sentences.en: That's an appalling accusation, and our men and women fight hard to protect people in our custody every single day.
sentences.zh: 这是一个骇人听闻的指责，我们的男女队员每天都在奋力保护我们羁押的人。

sentences.en: The agency spent Monday addressing another crisis after the investigative team at ProPublica revealed the existence of a private Facebook group made up of almost
sentences.zh: 周一，在独立调查团队ProPublica披露存在一个由近

sentences.en: 10,000 former and current Border Patrol agents, which features derogatory and insulting posts, including those of migrants and at least one of Congresswoman
sentences.zh: 10000名现任和前任边境巡逻队特工组成的私密Facebook群组后，该机构一直在处理另一场危机，该群组发布了贬低和侮辱性的帖子，其中包括针对移民以及至少国会女议员

sentences.en: Ocasio-Cortez.
sentences.zh: 奥卡西奥-科特斯的帖子。

sentences.en: Let me ask this question.
sentences.zh: 请允许我问这样一个问题。

sentences.en: The Times, my colleagues, we have been reporting on morale among Border Patrol agents.
sentences.zh: 《时报》、我的同事们，我们一直在报道边境巡逻队特工的士气问题。

sentences.en: What my colleagues have found is that it's fallen.
sentences.zh: 我的同事们发现，士气已经下降了。

sentences.en: It's gotten lower.
sentences.zh: 变得更低了。

sentences.en: I wonder why you think that is.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你认为这是为什么。

sentences.en: I don't think that the morale is where it should be.
sentences.zh: 我认为士气并没有达到应有的水平。

sentences.en: I think it could be better.
sentences.zh: 我认为本可以更好。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of it is it doesn't fall because of President Trump by no means.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很大程度上，士气下降绝对不是因为特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Why has it fallen then?
sentences.zh: 那为什么会下降呢？

sentences.en: Because it's a president that tries to enforce the immigration laws, and every time he's tried to do something, we have other people that jump in and they call it a raciSt.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个试图执行移民法的总统，而他每次试图做点什么，总有其他人跳出来称之为种族主义。

sentences.en: And then you have different congressional leaders that are going to our detention facilities and, you know, they're calling for the disbanding of some of our
sentences.zh: 然后你会看到不同的国会领导人前往我们的拘留设施，你知道的，他们呼吁解散我们的一些

sentences.en: law enforcement entities like ICE, like CBP.
sentences.zh: 执法实体，比如移民及海关执法局（ICE）、海关与边境保护局（CBP）。

sentences.en: I mean, that alone is demoralizing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，光是这一点就极其打击士气。

sentences.en: It sounds like you watch that very closely.
sentences.zh: 听起来你对这些关注得非常密切。

sentences.en: You have to.
sentences.zh: 你不得不这样做。

sentences.en: I mean, I represent agents that are working at these centers and when there's any individual that's going to enter these centers and walk out of there and actually say lies,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我代表着在这些中心工作的特工，当有任何人进入这些中心、走出去却公然说谎时，

sentences.en: I have to watch that
sentences.zh: 我必须关注这一点，

sentences.en: because these agents just can't talk about it because, you know, they're bound because of the agency.
sentences.zh: 因为这些特工根本无法对此发表言论，你知道的，因为他们受到机构的约束。

sentences.en: I'm the voice that has to come out and say these people are lying.
sentences.zh: 我是那个必须站出来说这些人是在撒谎的发声者。

sentences.en: When you say lying,
sentences.zh: 当你指责撒谎时，

sentences.en: I'm thinking, for example, about a congresswoman from New York,
sentences.zh: 我想到了，例如，纽约的一位国会女议员

sentences.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who visits a detention center and says she speaks to a woman and that woman says that she was told to drink water from a toilet.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯参观了一家扣留中心，她说她跟一位女性交谈过，而那位女性说她被告知要喝马桶里的水。

sentences.en: That's what that woman told Congresswoman
sentences.zh: 那位女性就是这么对国会女议员

sentences.en: Ocasio-Cortez.
sentences.zh: 奥卡西奥-科尔特斯说的。

sentences.en: I mean, so I guess the question would be is that what you, are those the things that you think of as being statements made by lawmakers that are untrue?

sentences.en: because it creates not just an unsafe environment for the individual that's being detained there but it creates an unsafe environment for the agents that work at these facilities.
